$comment: Single source of truth for the immutable refs that ci.yml and release.yml pin each sibling backend checkout to (§17 pin B). Each pinned commit CONTAINS the committed contract artifacts the gen:* drivers regenerate from: docs/schema.json, docs/flows.json, docs/errors.json, docs/capabilities.json (+ pyproject.toml for the manifest backend-version pin). Bumping a pin is a deliberate PR after the backend releases a new contract — never float main. Procedure: CONTRIBUTING.md, section 'Contract pins'. 2026-07-16: bumped to the v1-canon-sweep release tags (§60, api-versioning.md) — auth v0.5.8, notifications v0.3.8, profiles v0.3.13, billing v0.4.11, workspaces v0.4.2, calendar v0.3.4, recordings v0.3.2; all contracts now carry /<mod>/api/v1/ paths; react gen:* artifacts regenerated against these refs in the same change.

stapel-auth.note: release v0.12.0 — org-program security-harden primitives (W2+W3): login_grant (/grant/exchange/), first-login intermediates (FirstLoginChallengeResponse requires=password_change|mfa_enroll), /password/forced-change/, /mfa/enroll/exchange/ (enroll-only limited session), tokens on TOTP-confirm/passkey-complete for the enroll upgrade, auth.first_login flow. Pairs with @stapel/auth-react 0.9.0. Pin+regen bumped together (the discipline whose absence caused the earlier gen:check drift).

stapel-profiles.note: release v0.12.0 — the avatar/avatar_source pair invariant. A CDN reference stored with the model-default `file` tag routed to the PIL provider, which opened stapel-cdn's variant DIRECTORY as a plain file and 500'd GET /me and POST /batch; 2 of 2 profiles on the meettoday sandbox were stored that way, and the cascade (no display_name -> "enter your name" dialog at the meeting door -> its PATCH 500s on the same avatar) locked two people out of the product. The model now writes the source the reference implies, and a request that STATES a contradicting source is refused with the new error.400.avatar_source_mismatch. Also carries the Spanish error catalogue 0.11.0 tagged but never published (its contract gate failed). Pairs with @stapel/profiles-react's useSetAvatar, which transports the provenance instead of leaving the caller to remember it. Pin+regen bumped together.

stapel-workspaces.note: release v0.20.0 — the person states their home workspace. PUT/DELETE /me/preferred-workspace records and clears a per-user home workspace, and GET / echoes it as preferred_workspace_id under the same active-membership rule default_workspace_id already follows (else ""). It is the explicit choice DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID has documented itself as yielding to since 0.18 with nowhere to be recorded, which is why clients guessed and the guess that shipped was workspaces[0] off a -last_accessed_at-ordered list (#239: the owner's pending invitations sat in the org space while his screen showed his personal one). Stored as WorkspaceMember.is_preferred with a partial unique constraint (at most one per user), so the preference dies with the membership row and can never point at a workspace the person cannot open; a suspension silences the echo without destroying the flag. Refusals collapse to ONE error.404.workspace_not_found for unknown / non-member / pending / suspended, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe which workspace ids are real. Deliberately NOT last_accessed_at (telemetry, and reading it as a choice IS #239) and deliberately NOT a stapel-profiles field (only this module can validate against membership). Pairs with @stapel/workspaces-react's WorkspaceSelectionProvider / useWorkspaceSelection. Pin+regen bumped together. Still standing from v0.19.0 and unchanged here: the roster's two name-edit PATCHes, GET /instance, GET /'s is_guest + default_workspace_id, settings.security.capability_levels.
